title: conda environment dependency declared without a version
description: environment.yml declares an environment dependency with no version constraint and no build string. conda solves to the newest matching package at create time, so two environments made from the same file differ.
remediation: Pin the version and build string, and export the resolved environment file.
limitation: It matches an environment dependency with no version constraint and no build string in the parsed environment.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
